channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: India vs Pakistan: Emotions high, skies uncertain in Colombo
item.description: “After all, it’s just a match.” Not when India and Pakistan meet — especially on the stage of the ICC T20 World Cup.

item.title: India wedded to strategic autonomy: EAM Jaishankar amid US claims on Russian oil buys
item.description: Amid repeated assertions from the United States regarding New Delhi's purchases of Russian oil, India, reaffirming its "strategic autonomy", has conveyed a clear message on the global stage that its energy decisions will be determined by availability, cost, and risk considerations.

item.title: Bhojpuri star Pawan Singh’s ex-girlfriend Akshara Singh supports his wife Jyoti Singh’s demand of alimony
item.description: Actress Akshara Singh has come out in support of actor-politician Pawan Singh's wife Jyoti Singh. The actress has supported Jyoti Singh’s demand of alimony.

item.title: 12 people missing after boat sinks in Sudan
item.description: At least 12 people went missing after a boat carrying 16 passengers capsized in the Wad Al-Zaki area in central Sudan's White Nile State, according to volunteers and eyewitnesses.

item.title: Ram Charan applauds the passion of ‘Peddi’ maker Buchi Babu Sana as he turns a year older
item.description: Ram Charan applauded the passion and eye for detail of 'Peddi' maker Buchi Babu Sana as he turned a year older on Sunday.

item.title: Six arrested from Kolkata in two different theft cases
item.description: According to sources, a theft case was filed at Jorasanko police station on January 14, and the four were named as accused in the theft. Investigators had been searching for the accused for the past month. Finally, the four were arrested from Hasting's area on Saturday.

item.title: Devotees throng Shiva temples in Telugu states
item.description: A large number of devotees thronged Shiva temples across Telangana and Andhra Pradesh on Sunday as Maha Shivaratri celebrations commenced in both the Telugu states on a grand note.

item.title: T20 WC: ‘He doesn’t need any special advice…’, says Kuldeep’s childhood coach ahead of Pakistan clash
item.description: India spinner Kuldeep Yadav's childhood coach Kapil Dev Pandey lauded his ward's bowling prowess and stated that the left-arm wrist spinner doesn't need any special advice for the much-anticipated India-Pakistan clash in the T20 World Cup, as he has enough experience under his belt.

item.title: Indian student found dead six days after going missing in California
item.description: The Indian Consulate in San Francisco confirmed that local authorities recovered his body and assured that all necessary assistance would be provided to repatriate his remains to India as soon as possible.

item.title: Ranbir Kapoor calls ‘Ramayana’ releasing on Raha’s birthday ‘a beautiful coincidence’
item.description: Actor Ranbir Kapoor spilled some major updates about his upcoming films during a 'Ask Me Anything' session on Instagram.
